text.jp: ……少しでも後悔のない生き方をしたいな。
text.official_en: ...I can only hope that I’ll live a life where I can keep those to an absolute minimum.
text.real_en: ...I want to live a life with as few regrets as possible.

text.jp:
ああ……皆が寝静まってから剣を振っていたんだ。
今度ガベラダに泊まることがあったら
また訓練に使わせてもらおう。
text.official_en: The last time we visited, I practiced while everyone slept. I suppose I will do the same when we return.
text.real_en: Yeah... I practiced my swordsmanship after everyone else had gone to sleep. If we stay in Gaberada again, I'd like to train there.

text.jp:
ああすればよかった、こうすればよかった……。
そんなことの繰り返しでさ。
text.official_en: It’s a nonstop gut-punch parade of I-should-haves and if-onlys.
text.real_en: I keep thinking, 'I should've done this,' or 'I should've done that'... Again and again.

text.jp: あいつは武人だったな……。
text.official_en: A true warrior, that one...

text.jp:
いよいよ最後の戦いだな。
どんな場所でも俺が
エンタープライズで連れて行ってやる。
text.official_en: So this is it—our last battle. Wherever you need to go, I’ll make sure the <text style="italic">Enterprise</> gets you there.

text.jp:
おてんばなところもあるが、
夢に向かって真っすぐな妹なんだ。
text.official_en: She can be a handful sometimes, but when it comes to her dreams, she’s an honest kid.
text.real_en: She can be a bit of a tomboy, but my younger sister is completely devoted to her dream.

text.jp:
お休みになられたい時は
わたくしにお話しください。
text.official_en: May your airship feel no less than a home in the clouds. I shall see to it personally.
text.real_en: If you'd like to rest, please speak to me.

text.jp:
お前たちは世界を救うために
戦っているラリ？
エヴァンに聞いたラリ。
text.official_en: But anyway, I heard from Evan that you bunch are fighting to save the world, lali.
text.real_en: You're fighting to save the world, lali? That's what Evan told me.

text.jp: お前たちは勝つことだけに集中してくれ。
text.official_en: You just concentrate on winning the fight.

text.jp:
お金、お金って言うのは
アタシのキャラだからね。
兄さんには似合わないし。
text.official_en: Being a gil-pincher is <text style="italic">my</> thing. That shtick doesn’t suit him one bit.
text.real_en: Going on about money is my thing. It just doesn't suit Nii-san.

text.jp:
こうして旅をしていると、
いろいろとやり残したことに
思いを巡らせてしまうものじゃ。
text.official_en: As we journey along the road, I find myself pondering the bygone days that lie beyond my power to amend...
text.real_en: Traveling like this gets me thinking about all the things I've left unfinished.

text.jp:
こうして長い間ミシディアを
離れるのはいつ以来かのう……。
text.official_en: Long has it been since I was last absent from Mysidia for so protracted a period.
text.real_en: How long has it been since I spent this much time away from Mysidia...?

text.jp:
ここまできたんだから、最後まで頑張る……。
頑張ってみせるから。
text.official_en: We came all this way... I can’t give up—I won’t give up.
text.real_en: We've come this far, so I'll keep doing my best until the very end... I promise I will.

text.jp:
その代わりと言ってはなんだが、
リドのことをよろしく頼む。
text.official_en: Just please...keep an eye out for Lid in my stead, okay?

text.jp: その答えを追い求め、俺は鍛錬を続ける。
text.official_en: I can only hope to find my answer through my training.
text.real_en: I keep training in search of those answers.

text.jp:
それに……顔を出したいところもあるしな……。
時間ができたら、ミシディアに寄ってくれんかの？
text.official_en: On that thought, there is a particular locale I would like to visit. Might we arrange a visit to Mysidia when time allows?
text.real_en: And... there's somewhere I'd like to visit. Could we stop by Mysidia when we have time?

text.jp:
それは生きていく上で
何よりも大切なものじゃ。大事にせいよ。
text.official_en: There is naught of greater import than this in life. Cherish and treat your friends well.
text.real_en: There's nothing more important in life. Treasure them.

text.jp:
そんなの放っておけないからね！
オルデリオンは商業の中心地だから、
物資の補給は任せて！
text.official_en: Then you have the full support of the guild! Olderion is not the center of commerce for nothing. Please, let me help if you need any sort of supplies for your journey.
text.real_en: I can't just stand by and do nothing! Olderion is a center of commerce, so leave the supplies to me!

text.jp:
ただ、飛空艇内に宿を構えるのも
維持が大変でして……
心苦しいのですが、費用は頂戴します。
text.official_en: Although, erm...I do hesitate to say... I must ask a modest fee for the use of the beds. Running an inn aboard an airship has proven far more costly than we had ever imagined.
text.real_en: Running an inn aboard an airship is expensive... I'm sorry, but I'll have to charge a fee.

text.jp:
たまには、顔を見せないとな……。
時間ができたら、造船所に寄ってくれたら嬉しいな。
text.official_en: I should visit and say “hi” to them... I’d be super thankful if we could drop by the shipyard when we have the time.

text.jp:
でもさ、信じられないと思うんだよね。
シドが今も生きていて、アタシと戦ってるなんて聞いても。
text.official_en: Although, I’m not sure if he’d even believe me if I told him that not only is Cid alive, but we’ve been duking it out with him.
text.real_en: But I don't think he'd believe me, even if I told him Cid is still alive and I've been fighting him.

text.jp:
なにか買っていくラリ？
今扱っている商品はこれラリ。
text.official_en: Wanna buy something, lali? Here’s what I got in stock at the moment.

text.jp:
ねぇねぇ、レイン。
ミシディアの白魔道士さんたちって
私と格好が似てなかった？
text.official_en: So, Rain... I noticed that the white mages in Mysidia and I share similar outfits. Did you notice that, too?
text.real_en: Hey, Rain, didn't the white mages in Mysidia dress a lot like me?

text.jp:
みんなのところに戻ってこれて本当によかった。
もう消えたりしたくないな。
text.official_en: It’s good to be back with you guys again. Disappearing into thin air was frightening.
text.real_en: I'm so glad I could come back to everyone. I don't want to disappear again.

text.jp:
もしかしたら……何か関係があるのかな？
今度ミシディアに寄ったら、聞いてみようかな……。
text.official_en: Maybe I can find out more about myself from them? I think I’ll ask them next time we’re in Mysidia.
text.real_en: Maybe there's some connection between us... I wonder if I should ask them the next time we visit Mysidia.

text.jp:
アタシの夢を叶えるためにも、
ここで負けるわけにはいかない。
text.official_en: I can’t lose here—not when I have a dream to fulfill.

text.jp:
エンタープライズの
乗り心地はどうラリ？
text.official_en: How’s the <text style="italic">Enterprise</>? Smooth ride, eh, lali?

text.jp: エンタープライズの操縦は俺に任せてくれ。
text.official_en: I’ll pilot the <text style="italic">Enterprise</> anywhere you want, no problem.
text.real_en: Leave the piloting of the <text style="italic">Enterprise</> to me.

text.jp: ガベラダ……あそこでの訓練は集中できたな。
text.official_en: Although...come to think of it, I could not ask for a better training ground than Gaberada.
text.real_en: Gaberada... I could really concentrate on my training there.

text.jp:
シエラ様の命でレイン様と
そのお仲間のみなさまのお手伝いを
させていただきます。
text.official_en: By His Majesty’s command, I am now to assist you and your companions on your journey.
text.real_en:
By Shera-sama's order,
I'm here to assist Rain-sama
and all your companions.

text.jp: シドのこと兄さんに話した方がいいのかな……。
text.official_en: I’m torn over whether or not I should tell Evan the truth about Cid.
text.real_en: I wonder if I should tell Nii-san about Cid...

text.jp:
ディルマギアには、お世話になった人も多いんだ。
アタシと兄さん……みんなのおかげで
飛空艇技士になれたようなものだからさ。
text.official_en: There’s a whole bunch of people in Dilmagia who helped Evan and I become the airship engineers we are today.
text.real_en: A lot of people in Dilmagia helped us out. My older brother and I became airship engineers thanks to all of them.

text.jp:
レイン……。
お主はいい仲間に恵まれたようじゃのう。
text.official_en: Blessed is he who is held dear by many loyal companions. Rain, I speak of none other than yourself.
text.real_en: Rain... It seems you've been blessed with good friends.

text.jp:
レイン。
訓練をしたいんだが、飛空艇は揺れて足場が悪い。
どこか集中できるところがあればよいのだが……。
text.official_en: A moment, Rain. Training aboard the airship has proven to be a challenge with all the swaying. I was hoping to find a location better suited to practice my blade.

text.jp:
レインとラスウェルが羨ましいな。
だって戦ってわかり合うことができるんだもん。
text.official_en: I’m jealous of what you and Lasswell have. I mean, you two can understand each other completely just by fighting.

text.jp:
レイン様、わたくしは
シエラ様に仕えておりました者です。
text.official_en: A pleasure to make your acquaintance, Master Rain. I once served as Emperor Shera’s valet.
text.real_en:
Rain-sama, I once served
Shera-sama.

text.jp:
レイン隊長。
クロエ博士から言伝がございます。
text.official_en: Commander Rain, I have a message for you from Professor Chloe.

text.jp:
人はなぜ強くなろうとするのか。
誰かのためなのか。自分のためなのか。
text.official_en: What drives an individual to become stronger? I would say for some, it’s themselves. For others, it’s their loved ones.
text.real_en: Why do people strive to become stronger? For someone else? For themselves?

text.jp:
今こそ強さが必要な時だ。
鍛えてきた力を全て出し切るのみ。いくぞ。
text.official_en: Strength is what we need now more than ever. All that remains is for us to prove our prowess. Let’s go.
text.real_en: Now is the time we need strength. All we can do is give everything we've trained for. Let's go.

text.jp: 今の時代に初代シドがいてくれたらと思うよ。
text.official_en: But now, with airships being twisted into tools of war in a direct affront to his ideals...
text.real_en: I wish the First Cid were here in our time.

text.jp: 俺とリドにとって、初代シドは特別なんだ。
text.official_en: The First Cid holds a special place in Lid’s heart and mine.

text.jp: 兄さんが元に戻ってよかった。
text.official_en: Can’t stress enough how glad I am to have Evan back to normal.
text.real_en: I'm so glad Nii-san is back to his old self.

text.jp:
光輝の話を聞いて思ったんだけど……。
人生ってホントに思うようにならないよね。
text.official_en: You know, what Lux said really stuck with me... Life never goes the way you expect it to go.
text.real_en: Hearing what Radiance said got me thinking... Life really doesn't go the way you want it to, does it?

text.jp:
初代シドの最大の功績は何かと聞かれたら、
空への想いを人々に説いたことだと
俺は答える。
text.official_en: If asked about the First Cid’s greatest feat, I’d say without hesitation: he made others believe in the vast promise held by the skies.

text.jp:
劫火と戦ってからというもの
自分の力に自信がついた気がする。
text.official_en: Ever since our battle with Ignis, I feel a renewed confidence in my abilities.
text.real_en: Ever since I fought Inferno Veritas, I feel like I've grown more confident in my strength.

text.jp: 勝つよ、絶対に！
text.official_en: We’ll win this one. No matter what!

text.jp:
子供の頃に憧れた存在は永遠のもので、
その価値は何があっても変わるものではない。
text.official_en: Whatever may come, childhood heroes never lose their place there.
text.real_en: The people you admired as a child stay with you forever. Nothing can change their worth.

text.jp:
守り人のニコル様、
オルデリオンの街だけじゃなくて
今度は世界を守るために戦ってるんでしょ？
text.official_en: Is it true that you and Master Nichol now journey to save not just Olderion, but the whole world?
text.real_en: Nichol-sama, the Warden, is fighting to protect the whole world now, not just Olderion, right?

text.jp: 強くなりたいと思う理由は人それぞれだ。
text.official_en: Many push themselves to the same end, but rarely for the same reasons.
text.real_en: Everyone has their own reasons for wanting to become stronger.

text.jp:
強さとは何か……。
相手に勝つことの意味とは……。
text.official_en: What <text style="italic">is</> strength? What does it truly mean to surpass a rival?
text.real_en: What is strength...? And what does it mean to defeat an opponent...?

text.jp:
戦いには装備が必要ラリ。
だから、仕入れた武器や防具を
売ってやるラリ。
text.official_en: You need supplies for something that monumental. Fortunately, I’ve got you covered. I can sell you armor and weapons, lali.
text.real_en: You'll need equipment for battle, lali. That's why I'm selling the weapons and armor I've stocked up on!

text.jp:
新しい商品を仕入れたラリ！
ぜひ見ていってほしいラリ。
text.official_en: Got some fresh inventory, lali! Come take a look.

text.jp:
新しい商品を入荷したわ。
今までより役に立つと思うの。
さ、見てって見てって。
text.official_en: I have some new goods up for sale—dare I say, loads better than the stuff I used to carry! Come and see.
text.real_en: We've got new goods in stock. I think they'll be more useful than what we had before. Come take a look!

text.jp:
珍しいものを手に入れたので
時間がある時にナシャトに会いに来てほしい
とのことです。
text.official_en: She wants you to know that she “found something interesting,” and is requesting that you visit her in Felicitas at your earliest convenience.

text.jp:
私、飛空艇大好き！
空を飛ぶのってすごく気持ちいいから。
text.official_en: I love airships! It just feels nice zooming through the skies.

text.jp:
私がもっと強くなったらレインと勝負できるかな。
ふふ。なんてね。
text.official_en: Maybe if I get stronger, I can fight you one day, too, Rain... Hehe, I’m just kidding.

text.jp:
私はオルデリオンの商業組合から
派遣されてきたのよ。以後よろしくね。
text.official_en: Hi there. I’ve been sent by the Olderion Merchant’s Guild to help you with supplies.
text.real_en: I'm here on assignment from the Olderion merchants' guild. I look forward to working with you.

text.jp:
自分もエヴァンを手伝って
エンタープライズをつくったラリ！
だから、ついに飛んで嬉しいラリ。
text.official_en: I added the finishing touches with Evan, too! I’m as excited as he is that she’s finally soaring the skies, lali!
text.real_en: I helped Evan build the <text style="italic">Enterprise</>, too! I'm so happy it's finally flying, lali!

text.jp:
船と列車とチョコボも大好き。
私、乗り物ならなんでも好きかも。
text.official_en: I also like riding trains...and chocobos, too. Come to think of it, I guess I like anything that you can ride on.
text.real_en: I love boats, trains, and chocobos, too. I guess I might just like every kind of transport!

text.jp:
補給は戦いの要なのよ！
……って、これニコル様の口癖なんだけどね。
さ、見てって見てって。
text.official_en: Logistics are the key to victory!...is what Master Nichol always says. So, come take a look.
text.real_en: Supply lines are the key to victory!... That's something Nichol-sama always says. Come on, take a look!

text.jp:
飛空艇は彼の思いに反して、
戦争の道具にされつつあるからな。
text.official_en: The world needs people like him more than ever.
text.real_en: Airships are becoming tools of war, against everything he hoped for.
